main_body: Market stall counter (wooden counter body, rows ~26-42) under a striped awning, with produce on the counter top
top_band: light tan-brown counter top, rows ~26-29, with a pinkish highlight at the front edge around rows 28-29; produce sits on it
evidence: Reading a centre column: the dark awning and shelf area comes first, then the lighter counter-top band (rows 26-29) with goods standing on it. A highlighted front-edge row follows, then a darker eave row, then the 12-row brown front face with a central seam and speckle. This matches the reference stall construction, with a readable horizontal top above a vertical face. The top is thin but still a surface rather than a rim. The front panels are painted flat with no inset, but the top, edge line and shadow are enough to avoid a pure front elevation.

style.evidence: The awning has several green and cream steps with fold shading. The produce is shaded and the outlines lean dark purple-brown rather than neutral black. The counter front carries wood grain dots and a seam, though its large lower area is relatively plain. It sits close to the reference stall and is not noticeably thinner or more sticker-like.
